[control] r_e cloud mean divides by float(len) instead of len
mutants.why: `float / int` converts the int operand to a float before the one IEEE division, so `fsum(values) / len(values)` and `fsum(values) / float(len(values))` divide the same two doubles (a count of 17 is exactly representable) and return the identical number on every path; it would differ only for a count above 2**53 or a non-float fsum, which a 17-point transect never reaches.
